lead: Newest clear Sentinel-2 pass over BWMA since wet-up began — for release calibration, not the monthly composite.
method_details: Prefilter: granule CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE < 90 (whole Sentinel-2 tile, not the AOI). Acceptance: over the BWMA bounding box at 20 m, aoi_cloud_frac = count(SCL in {8,9,10}) / count(SCL != 0) must be <= 20%. The usable scene with the latest system:time_start is kept. Acreage is NIR reflectance < threshold on that single scene after masking SCL in {0,3,8,9,10} (no data, cloud shadow, medium cloud, high cloud, cirrus). Displayed threshold 0.16 (raised from 0.14 to include dark fringe wet pixels in fall imagery). This is not a 15-day median composite. Total acreage excludes Drew (not in current rotation; often Blackrock ditch / reddish false positives); Drew row kept for QA.
cloud_rule: Newest clear Sentinel-2 pass over BWMA since wet-up began — for release calibration, not the monthly composite.
map_note: False-color PNG for the Folium map is warped to EPSG:4326 so the image overlay matches unit GeoJSON; downloadable GeoTIFF stays in the EE export CRS (typically UTM 11N).
threshold_note: Fall fringe calibration (Drew excluded from Total): Sep 29 scene 0.14=104.3, 0.15=111.1, 0.16=118.1, 0.18=132.7 ac. Displayed 0.16. Mid-month composites remain at 0.14 unless Desk decides otherwise. Drew excluded from Total (not in current rotation; detections often Blackrock ditch / reddish false positives).
